It's time for a new update, peeps! In this cozy little update, we've fine-tuned your beloved farming adventure, making under-the-hood tweaks for an even smoother ride across your fields!

Big Farm Story launches a fully-offline mode for you to keep your farm adventures with you. Learn more in the full changelist below:[/b]
 
[b]Added: [/b]

[list]
[*] Offline Mode (Beta) - Start a new game in offline mode. Offline characters do not have access to certain online-only features such as becoming friends with other players or visiting their farms. Saved files are stored on your computer and persisted via Steam Cloud if you have it active.
[/list] [list]
[*] Many technical improvements!
[/list] 

[b]Take care! [/b]

The character models have been splitted into many single parts:  body, clothes, skin color, head, face, hair and hair color as well as beard and beard color. notes.title: Big Farm Story Update 1.5 - Local Co-op Feature
notes.content:
[b]Are you ready for another great update, peeps? True friends do everything together, so why not play Big Farm Story with your mate. Grab a second controller and discover the brand new local co-op feature. Of course, we also did some improvements. Please see the full changelist below:[/b]

[b]Added: [/b]
[list]
[*] Local Co-op: Grab a second controller and invite a friend to play Big Farm Story together! Thereby, one player is playing the character and the other gets to play as the pet. The pet offers many new features and actions to help on the farm while local co-op event is running. A friend can join and leave your game any time for local co-op without you having to restart your progress
[/list] [list]
[*] Rotate decorations: Most decorations and furniture can now be rotated to allow more freedom in designing your farm and home
[/list] [list]
[*] New anecdote - Learn more about Rita in her anecdote quest, which is unlocked from friendship level 2
[/list] [list]
[*] Upgrade inventory: Learn in a new side quest how to increase the inventory size
[/list] [list]
[*] Seed bags: Info text will now show seed growth time when buying  
[/list] [list]
[*] Benny's milk quest: The guidance for this quest has been improved for players who haven't unlocked a cow at this point 
[/list] [list]
[*] Farm house decoration: Improved access to spots in the farm house when using a controller
[/list] [list]
[*] Several animation, sound and particle improvements
[/list]

[b]Take care! [/b]

notes.title: Big Farm Story Update 1.4
notes.content:
[b][i]When black cats prowl and pumpkins gleam, may luck be yours on Halloween! [/i]

Peeps, get yourself ready for the most spooky time of the year with our big Halloween update. Discover a brand new scene, a spine-chilling new event with great surprises and so much more... [/b]

[b]Added:[/b]
[list]
[*] New seasonal event: Shiver Night - Help the villagers prepare for Shiver Night, the big seasonal Halloween event. Complete the quests during the Halloween season to win rewards that can only be gained during this seasonal event. You need to have reached chapter five to get access to most of the seasonal event quests.
[/list] [list]
[*] New scene: Chestnut meadow - Discover Chestnut meadow and unlock this scene with the big sweet chestnut tree that gave the valley its name. Chestnut meadow is the place where the villagers celebrate all seasonal festivals.
[/list] [list]
[*] New anecdotes - Get to know Jacob, Hannah and Levi. With this update, we added an anecdote for each of them. You can unlock it by having the required friendship level with them.
[/list] [list]
[*] Faster and cheaper crops: Don't like waiting? The growth time of many crops has been reduced so that none takes longer than three days now and in addition the purchase price for many seed bags was reduced too
[/list] [list]
[*] Faster pet leveling: Leveling-up your pets is now cheaper
[/list] [list]
[*] More decoration spots - Discover a few more decoration spots on your farm to beautify it even more 
[/list] [list]
[*] Solution for overproducing - From now on, it's no longer possible to produce more goods at a facility than what currently fits in the player's inventory
[/list] [list]
[*] Fixed issue with players getting stuck when exchanging decorations and furniture
[/list]

[b]Happy Halloween! 
Take care! 
[/b]

notes.title: Big Farm Story Update 1.3
notes.content:
[b]Are you ready for another great update, peeps? Discover a new pet, reach new achievements and enjoy a lot of convenience features and improvements. Please see the full changelist below:[/b]

[b]Added:[/b]
[list]
[*] New pet - Pet lovers wanted! Unlock a super cute new pet with friendship tokens: the spotted piglet.. isn't it adorable?
[/list] [list]
[*] More achievements - Are you looking for an extra challenge? Enjoy a handful new Steam achievements
[/list] [list]
[*] New anecdote quest - It's time to learn more about Lydia. With this update, we added the first anecdote for her. You can unlock it by having the required friendship level with her
[/list] [list]
[*] New language - You asked for it, you get it. Big Farm Story is now available in Spanish. ¡Pasadlo bien!
[/list] [list]
[*] Carrot Seed Drops - Carrots now also have a chance to drop seeds when you harvest them
[/list] [list]
[*] New Voucher Code System - With this update, we introduce the voucher code system. In your journal, you can now enter voucher codes to unlock great gifts. Stay tuned, we are planning to give out codes during special events
[/list] [list]
[*] Convenience: Gifting - Giving a gift to a NPC friend happens now much faster
[/list] [list]
[*] Convenience: Energy - From now on, it is easier and faster to eat multiple dishes for quickly refilling your energy
[/list] [list]
[*] Convenience: Selling - When selling something, the list of items will no longer jump to the top after every time an item was sold
[/list] [list]
[*] Controller Support - Enjoy the new quick-action wheel that allows you to fastly access functions with the controller
[/list] [list]
[*] Improvements - Trees: Improved information, e.g. remaining growth time has been added
[/list] [list]
[*] Improvements - Collision issues with some trees in the woods have been fixed, to avoid that players may get stuck in them
[/list][list]
[*]  Improvements: Stickers - From now on, stickers are named skills to improve understandability of this function
[/list] [list]
[*] Improvements: Energy bar - The button below the energy bar has been changed into a food icon to make the function more clear
[/list] [list]
[*] Improvements: Dialog - The dialog that appears while selecting a decoration slot is now better understandable
[/list] [list]
[*] Improvements: Main Menu - An information of the optional DLCs can now be found in the main menu
[/list]

[b]Take care![/b]

notes.title: Big Farm Story Update 1.2
notes.content:
[b]It's time for another great update, peeps! With this update, we introduce the next bunch of fan features. Of course, we also did some further improvements. Please see the full changelist:[/b]

[b]Added:[/b]
[list]
[*] New feature: Alpaca Taxi - With this update, we introduce the alpaca taxi. Progress through the story to unlock it and you can travel to some destinations instantaneously. 
[/list] [list]
[*] New feature: Rain - Hurray it rains! A good farmer loves a rainy day because it means that fields do not need to be watered
[/list] [list]
[*] New feature: Seed return - You feel like selling crops doesn't bring you enough profit and don't want to wait for the best market contracts? We have got you covered: Every time you harvest crops there is now a good chance that you get seeds back allowing you to farm much more without having to buy as many seed bags! The chance for getting seeds when harvesting varies between the different crops.
[/list] [list]
[*] Cheaper decorations - You love to decorate your house, but don't want to wait until you earned tons of coins at the market? Discover new furniture and farm decorations in Owen's and Amelia's store with an extra low coin price to get started and to makes things even better they also reduced prices for the existing decorations!
[/list] [list]
[*] New craft-able decorations -  Owen has a load of new stickers in his store that unlock the crafting of various farm decorations and even new building skins.
[/list] [list]
[*] Convenience: Well - From now on, water at the well is not limited anymore. So, fill your inventory with water as often as you like!
[/list] [list]
[*] Convenience: 2nd Well - What is better than one well? Two wells! Unlock a second well in the location that has the additional fields
[/list] [list]
[*] Balancing: Fishing - You love to be a fisherman? Great news, fish will now always respawn, so you can spend the whole day fishing if you want to! 
[/list] [list]
[*] Balancing: Building materials - Don't want to wait for getting the right materials in your market contracts? Great news, you can now craft screws and roofing shingles at your workbench.
[/list] [list]
[*] Balancing: Logs - You feel like getting logs takes too long? We've got you covered. From now on, more logs will spawn in all scenes, where you can find them.
[/list] [list]
[*] Balancing: From now on, you get more energy from all food dishes.
[/list] [list]
[*] Balancing: Unlocking the later fields is now much cheaper.
[/list] [list]
[*] Balancing: Not needed market materials can now be sold for extra coins in Amelia's and Owen's stores.
[/list] [list]
[*] Improvements: Animal store - In addition to giving your grown animals to the care of other farmers, you can now also earn care tokens by exchanging animal products in Jacob's store.
[/list] [list]
[*] Improvements: Mathilda's Market - There is a new side quest asking to upgrade contract slots and sizes, because that's how you can earn much more money at the market.
[/list] [list]
[*] Improvements: Fields - The unlock order of fields is now better visible 
[/list] [list]
[*] Improvements: Pet list - The pet list has been cleaned up to avoid confusion
[/list] [list]
[*] Improvements: Collision issues in mountains have been fixed, so that players won't get stuck in them 
[/list] [list]
[*] Improvements: Mo's Alpaca delivery - From now on, the alpaca delivery timer will immediately end once you go to sleep 
[/list] [list]
[*] DLC - Do you want to support the development of the game and enjoy some extra farm decorations, building skins and furniture in addition to all the free ones we added in this update? Then go check out our new optional DLC packages "Peaceful Nature" and "Pet Paradise"
[/list]

[b]Take care! [/b]

notes.title: Big Farm Story Charity Event
notes.content:
Hi peeps! Today we are going to introduce you to the other regions where our partner One Tree Planted is supporting tree planting projects. Let’s check out Latin America, Africa and the Pacificːsteamhappyː. 
[list]
[*] In Latin America One Tree Planted supports projects in the Amazon Rainforest, the Andes, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Guatemala, Haití, Honduras, México and Perú. The focus lies on rebuilding forests and restoring land to improve the health of tropical forests. Moreover, they support the communities to improve forest management practices and agricultural techniques like agroforestry.
[/list][list]
[*] The projects in Africa are focussing on rebuilding animal habitat and restoring soil and critical watersheds. These actions also help to improve the lives of the communities as they rely on the forests. The different projects are located in Côte d'Ivoire, Ethiopia, Ghana, Kenya, Malawi, Rwanda, Tanzania and Uganda.
[/list][list]
[*] In The Pacific region, One Tree Planted supports different projects in Australia and across New Zealand. The focus is on supporting reforestation in the Pacific by restoring forests after the destruction by bushfires; regenerating critical habitat for wildlife like koalas and cockatoos; and safeguarding community watersheds through restoration of indigenous tree species.
[/list]
Thank you all for participating in our voting and supporting us in doing something good for our planet! Stay tuned for the next steps in our charity event and take care!

notes.title: Big Farm Story & One Tree Planted
notes.content:
Hi peeps! To give you a little insight into our charity event, we will share some facts about the regions you can vote for. Let’s check out North America, Europe and Asia todayːsteamhappyː. 
[list]
[*] In North America One Tree Planted is supporting several projects in various US states, across three Canadian provinces, and in Mexico. The focus is on restoring forests after major wildfires and repairing damage caused by industry and resource extraction.
[/list][list][*] There is a growing number of projects in Europe. One Tree Planted supports their partners in re-establishing woodland, improving water and soil quality, and creating habitat for wildlife. The tree planting projects are located in Spain, Romania, Iceland and Denmark.
[/list][list][*] In Asia, One Tree Planted works together with their partners to rebuild the habitat of critically endangered species like orangutans, tigers, and more than 1,700 species of birds. The supported projects help to create jobs and provide sustainable, long-term income for communities. The different projects are located in India, Indonesia, Vietnam and the Philippines.
[/list]
Next week we will introduce you to the other regions, so stay tuned and don’t forget to cast your vote in our pinned discussion! Have a good one and take care!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38246324/96537fc2b6af8729f45e63f65b8399962d519f3f.png[/img]

notes.title: Big Farm Story Update 1.1
notes.content:
[b]It's time for the first update after our great 1.0 release! Peeps, enjoy much more surprise quests, a new fishing feature and lots of convenience and balancing improvements. 
Please see the full changelist below:[/b]

[b]Added:[/b]
[list]
[*] Surprise quests - You'd better check your mailbox! It's time to enjoy 79 brand new surprise quests. And you should also know, helping a NPC friend in need is now even more rewarding: You get an additional third reward as a sign of appreciation.  
[/list][list]
[*] New fishing feature: Fish traps - From now on, we make your fisherman life a bit more easy. Find destroyed fishing traps, repair these and get fish without catching them by yourself 
[/list][list]
[*] Preservation shelves - You like the preservation shelves as much as we do? Great, with this update, more shelves can be unlocked 
[/list][list]
[*] Controller Support - Enjoy the new button shortcut which lets you access the market dialog super fast
[/list][list]
[*] Convenience: Watering- Watering a crop that is already growing is now much faster with less clicks
[/list][list]
[*] Convenience: Crafting - Items that can be crafted instantly, will be collected automatically
[/list][list]
[*] Convenience: Crafting - Use the slider to craft multiple items at the same time 
[/list][list]
[*] Convenience: Animals - Discover the new indicator for your hungry animals. So, you will never miss feeding them
[/list][list]
[*] Convenience: Minigames - Hitting the sweet spot while chopping wood and mining makes you finish the minigame faster
[/list][list]
[*] Balancing: Food - From now on, you can either give your cooked dishes to Claire to get cooking tokens or sell them in the farm box to gain even more coins faster 
[/list][list]
[*] Balancing: Gifts - Receive more friendship points for all gifts to increase the friendship levels faster 
[/list]
[b]Improvements: [/b]
[list]
[*] Polished cutscenes and several small glitches fixed, e.g. pet is not interfering with cutscenes anymore 
[/list][list]
[*] Further polishing and improvements for controller support 
[/list]
[b]Take care! [/b]

notes.title: Big Farm Story Update 1.0
notes.content:
[b]It's time for a new update, peeps! Stay tuned for more exciting news, we will share later today. For now, please see the full changelist below:
[/b]
[b]Added: [/b]

notes.title: Big Farm Story - Great News
notes.content:
[h3]Hi Peeps! [/h3]
First of all, thank you very much for your support since we’ve launched Big Farm Story on Steam back in August 2020. We are happy to know that we have such a great community. 
Your feedback as well as all of your ideas and suggestions were helping us a lot over the last couple of months on our exciting journey with Big Farm Story. 

Today, there is some great news we would like to share with you: [b]the Early Access phase of Big Farm Story is coming to an end soon and we are launching a full version of our game this summer![/b] After experimenting with the in-game shop for furniture items and gathering your feedback we decided to change that approach. We will remove the in-game shop with the next update and there won’t be any other ingame-purchases in the game too. We are also dedicated to removing other elements that were perceived as feeling too much like a mobile game, such as the real-time timers, and will continue to improve this based on your feedback. For example, we will soon allow you to refill your energy by eating all the delicious meals you cooked to make this feature even better!  

But now, let’s talk about the roadmap. For the big release version we are implementing lots of fan favorites and features you have asked for in the forum. Once the last big game mechanics are completed we will focus on what you requested the most: more story and things to unlock!

So, we are more than happy to share an outlook on what is yet to come in the following months: 
[list] [*] Eat your cooked food to refill your energy during the day
[/list] [list] [*] NPC friendships, quests and so much more
[/list] [list]
[*] Continuing the story in new areas such as the Rusty Hook with even more new characters to meet
[/list] [list]
[*] More Multiplayer features - Help your friends when you visit their farm!
[/list] [list]
[*] Much more seeds, fields, animals, recipes & gathering items!
[/list] [list]
[*] Restart the game when you want to experience the story again and see all the new improvements we did there
[/list] [list]
[*] Remove real-time timers such as the market contracts trashing and the daily goal timer 
[/list] [list]
[*] A lot of rebalancing to stop slowing down your progression once we added all the cool content to unlock
[/list] [list]
[*] Steam Achievements to unlock
[/list]

We hope you are as excited as we are. Stay tuned, more information will be shared soon.
Take care!

notes.title: Big Farm Story Update - 0.25
notes.content:
[b]A brand-new update is live, peeps. With this update, we introduce the daily cycle and the energy & sleeping system. So, prepare yourself for some major changes in Big Farm Story. Of course, we also did some fixes and improvements. Please see the full changelist:[/b]

[b]Added:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Daily Cycle[/b] - With this update, we introduce the daily cycle. From now on, your day in Big Farm Story always starts at 6:00 AM and ends at 12:00 AM. In real-time, this means that an in-game day takes about 12 minutes. All in-game activities, like harvesting, crafting, gathering spots, water and animals, have been adjusted to the new cycle as well. The crops now take a certain number of in-game days to grow and need to be watered every day to make them sprout. As before, you just need to go to the well to water them. The well will be refilled after each in-game day and the water should last for all your plants. You can also upgrade your well to increase your water storage. As a last resort—if you ever run out—you can get some water at Amelia’s Store. The same procedure with the daily cycle applies to your animals. The animal products need a specific number of in-game days to be completed. You must also remember to pet your animal and give it a treat once per day—this is a crucial step. Dishes cooked in your kitchen and animal feed crafted in your mill will be finished instantly.
Some features, such as the daily goal timer, the alpaca delivery cool-down and the market refresh, have a different timer and do not depend on the daily cycle.
[/list]

[list]
[*] [b]Energy[/b] - Another big change is that your character now needs energy to experience all the adventures in the world of Big Farm Story. To keep track of all this, check out the energy bar on your screen: it shows you when to be careful with your energy and even when you need some sleep. Imagine you are starting a brand-new morning from your cozy bed in the farmhouse, full of energy. Now you are ready for the day. But be aware the actions and things you are doing cost energy. In order to restore energy, you just need to get some sleep.
[/list]

[list]
[*] [b]Sleeping[/b] - By the time you decide to go to bed and refill your energy, your exciting day ends. You’ll get an overview of the previous day, to see what you did and achieved. In order to wake up again and start the new day, you just have to close this overview. And always keep in mind, your bed is the best place to sleep; by resting there, your energy will be fully restored. Last but not least, be aware that the day must advance to the afternoon before you can go to bed. Because who wants to go to bed early, right?
[/list]

[b]We hope you enjoy the daily cycle as much as we do.
Take care![/b]

[b]A brand-new update is live. Peeps, discover the big animal barn, even more cute animals on the farm, and some fixes and improvements![/b]

Added:
[list]

[list]
[*] Improved Field Blocker visuals, which make it easier to see the order you can unlock fields in.
[*] Adjustments to chicken costs and stats. Chickens are now cheaper to buy for coins, but the selling price has been reduced.
[*] Adjustments to requirements for crafting small animal feed. You can now produce more feed in the same amount of time. The corresponding costs have been increased respectively.
[*] Adjustment to timing of trash market contracts from Level 22 on (reduced to 15 minutes).
[*] Improved crafting times at the mill (reduced by 5% per upgrade).
